ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity region (low RGB values) covering both lobes. Medium-intensity (grey) mottled clusters at the fluke-peduncle junction. Fine medium-intensity linear streaks localized on the medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits significant high-amplitude, irregular peaks (approx. 5-10 pixels) creating a ragged profile toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the anterior margins; posterior margins exhibit a combination of linear and slightly concave segments between the tips and the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approx. 3-6 pixels in diameter) localized along the distal margins of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned linear pixel disruptions; a prominent diagonal scratch on the inner left lobe and vertical rake marks on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma manifested as a ragged/frayed margin at the right distal tip with irregular tissue loss; distinct parallel rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive frayed or 'feathered' visual texture on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip, contrasting sharply with the smoother profile of the left lobe tip.
